description: The full win-x64 runtime for the self-hosted Gatherlight family planner, in one download-at-setup package: the Playwright driver + portable git (MinGit) + chromium headless-shell. The app pulls it once at first-run setup via the nuget.org flat-container API (not a build-time PackageReference), keeping the app download lean. Redistributes Microsoft Playwright (Apache-2.0), Node.js (MIT), Chromium headless-shell (BSD-3-Clause), and git-for-windows/MinGit (GPL-2.0).
licenseExpression: Apache-2.0 AND MIT AND BSD-3-Clause AND GPL-2.0-only
